senses.gloss: (b. h.) to be lessened.—[Lev. R. s. 33 אלא נכה, some ed., v. אָנָךְ.]

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 10:3">Ḥull. X, 3</cite> <he>ואינו מְנַכֶּה לו וכ׳</he> and the seller is not bound to allow him a reduction for the priest’s share.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 7:2">B. Bath. VII, 2</cite>, sq. <he>יְנַכֶּה</he> he must make an allowance for what there is less than specified in the contract.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20:7">Num. R. s. 20</cite> (ref. to <he>נכה</he>, <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 22:6">ib. XXII, 6</cite>) <he>כמי שמְנַכֶּה אחד מכ״ד לסאה</he> as one (purchasing grain) is prepared for a deficiency of one twenty-fourth for each S’ah (allowance for chaff, v. <cite ref="I00396"><he>טִינּוֹפֶת</he></cite>); Tanḥ. Balak 4 (not <he>למאה</he>); ed. Bub. 6; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:4">Cant. R. to III, 4</cite> <he>שנכה מסנחריב</he> some ed., read <he>שנָכַת</he>, v. <cite ref="N00832"><he>נְכִיתָה</he></cite>.]
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 8:1">B. Kam. VIII, 1</cite> <he>הִכָּהוּ חייב וכ׳</he> if he hit him (created a sore), he must pay for curing him.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 8:3">Ib. 3</cite> <he>המַכֶּה את וכ׳</he> if a person strikes his father &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 9:2">Snh. IX, 2</cite> <he>נתכוין להַכּוֹתוֹ וכ׳</he> if he intended to hit him on his loins. Y. Peah I, 16ᵃ bot. (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 120:3">Ps. CXX, 3</cite>, sq.) <he>כל כלי זיין מַכִּין וכ׳</he> all weapons strike in their place, but this (calumny) strikes at a distance; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מוּכֶּה</he>; f. <he>מוּכָּה</he>; pl. <he>מוּכִּים</he>, <he>מוּכִּין</he>; <he>מוּכּוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 7:10">Keth. VII, 10</cite>, a. fr. <he>מוּכֵּה שהין</he> afflicted with leprosy.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 1:3">Ib. I, 3</cite>, a. fr. <he>מוּכַּת עץ</he> one who lost her hymen through an accidentallesion.
<cite ref="Mishnah Parah 8:9">Par. VIII, 9</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 1:8">Mikv. I, 8</cite>, v. <cite ref="M01199"><he>מַיִם</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 1:7">Yoma I, 7</cite> <he>מַכִּין לפניו באצבע וכ׳</he> snap their middle-fingers.
<cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 2:3">Arakh. II, 3</cite>, v. <cite ref="H01045"><he>חָלִיל</he></cite>; a. fr.
